name: dock-text
title: Dock Text
description: A pointer glides across a line of capitals and the letters near it stretch tall like a dock, the nearest one most, easing back to size when the pointer leaves.
useWhen: A short bold word in capitals should react to a moving pointer with a magnified, dock-style swell.
A playful interactive-feeling headline for a video.
avoidWhen: The text should stay calm: use per-character-rise.
Lowercase or long sentences: the stretch reads best on a short word.
author: Eldora UI

variables.label: Text
variables.description: A short word or phrase; it is shown in capitals.

variables.label: Grow downward
variables.description: Anchor the stretch at the top so letters grow downward.

variables.label: Pointer enters
variables.description: Seconds before the pointer reaches the first letter.

variables.label: Sweep time
variables.description: Seconds the pointer takes to cross the text.

variables.label: Font size
variables.description: Text size in pixels. The source is built for 72px type; its pixel offsets scale with this size.
